Usage: sst secret set <name> [value]

Flags:
  --stage          The stage to deploy to
  --verbose        Enable verbose logging
  --print-logs     Print logs to stderr
  --config         Path to the config file
  --help           Print help
  --fallback       Manage the fallback values of secrets

Examples:
  sst secret set StripeSecret 123456789
  sst secret set StripeSecret < tmp.txt
  sst secret set StripeSecret productionsecret --stage production

Learn more at https://sst.dev
